en: The image shows the reverse side of a vintage postcard. It contains handwritten text in blue ink, a postage stamp in the upper right corner, and a postmark. The address is written on the right side, and the left side has a message. The stamp and postmark indicate it was sent within Hungary, and the address includes the city of Szeged. There is also a publisher's mark, 'Barasits Budapest,' at the bottom.
